systems_review_input: Systems must preserve the stable policy lineage or canonical CVE/package identity described in its draft.
fleet_cves_review_input: Fleet rows aggregate canonical CVE/package pairs; mutation subjects add exact authorized systems.
compliance_finding: Policy findings use system plus policy lineage. Exact-CVE plans retain their distinct family.
joint_review_question: Approve the identity dictionary and prohibit conversions based only on matching display names.

systems_review_input: System Current, exact configuration, and retained-generation selections need separate meanings.
fleet_cves_review_input: Current exposure, scheduled deployment target, and Historical inventory are separate relations.
compliance_finding: Bundle version selects membership; it is not a deployment or observation identity.
joint_review_question: Define a typed selection envelope and explicit unavailable state for each target kind.

systems_review_input: The Systems draft leaves the read-only scan-fallback question open.
fleet_cves_review_input: Inventory can contain read-only scheduled/historical rows that cannot authorize fleet triage.
compliance_finding: Evaluation-attempt fallback can display output without current deployed-target binding.
joint_review_question: Approve display-only fallback separately from mutation and closure prerequisites.

treatment: Must agree for the same observation
systems_review_input: System policy evidence must be checked against the approved effective-policy compatibility contract.
fleet_cves_review_input: Exact occurrence evidence is not itself a composite policy assessment.
compliance_finding: Matrix, detail, and verifier currently select against differing digest rules.
joint_review_question: Choose one compatible assessment-set resolver, with explicit family-specific inputs.

contract: Newest report versus last valid report
systems_review_input: Current system state must not silently mean an older valid report unless labeled last-known.
fleet_cves_review_input: Exact Current authority must not substitute an unrelated older target.
compliance_finding: Policy verification and other selectors do not all apply validation after selecting the newest report.
joint_review_question: Test a newer invalid report and decide a consistent Current/last-known distinction.

systems_review_input: A system can have a CVE threshold policy failure and separate exact vulnerability findings.
fleet_cves_review_input: Exact CVE/package presence supplies vulnerability subjects, not policy lineage.
compliance_finding: Policy evaluation can use completed scan counters without producing exact-CVE finding identity.
joint_review_question: Keep both families typed. Define explicit relationships rather than treating them as duplicates.

systems_review_input: System detail, summary, and navigation must respect current environment visibility.
fleet_cves_review_input: The CVEs draft describes environment scoping before occurrence counts and rollups.
compliance_finding: Some Compliance catalog/systems handlers do not carry the scope used by evidence and POA&M routes.
joint_review_question: Use one scope contract and prove every endpoint, export, and autocomplete path.

systems_review_input: Distinguish an unassigned system from missing scan data or an inaccessible system.
fleet_cves_review_input: Admin-visible unassigned inventory does not automatically create environment-scoped mutation subjects.
compliance_finding: Catalog/matrix visibility and plan access need the same explicit unassigned rule.
joint_review_question: Specify read visibility, action availability, and non-enumerating errors without treating missing fields as zero.

systems_review_input: System counts, control results, and related plan counts are separate quantities.
fleet_cves_review_input: Pairs, current/scheduled/historical systems, and actionable subjects have different units.
compliance_finding: Requirement versions, controls, policy/CVE findings, and plans coexist; compact plan counts omit the CVE family.
joint_review_question: Document units on each field and label. Reconcile by set identity, not by comparing unrelated totals.

systems_review_input: A system status must not imply every requirement has a mapped and executed policy.
fleet_cves_review_input: Accepted or scheduled vulnerability disposition does not mean remediation is verified.
compliance_finding: Full requirement mapping can coexist with failed, missing, or erroneous policy evidence and open plans.
joint_review_question: Keep mapping coverage, observed result, disposition, and remediation lifecycle separate in every view.

systems_review_input: System triage and policy control waivers need distinct identity and effects.
fleet_cves_review_input: CVE acceptance records risk; it is not exact scan absence or a policy waiver.
compliance_finding: Policy waiver verification binds to an observation/version and can satisfy its policy-family closure rule.
joint_review_question: Approve terminology and complete entry points. Do not unify these merely because both say accepted.

systems_review_input: System host decisions override the environment default; clearing an override is not necessarily opening the finding.
fleet_cves_review_input: Fleet rollups and environment ownership must account for host overrides explicitly.
compliance_finding: A CVE-originated plan shown in Compliance must retain that subject ownership and not assume a bundle scope.
joint_review_question: Define effective disposition, default scope, and owned subjects as separate fields.

systems_review_input: System deployment changes must retain old evidence while independently resolving new current evidence.
fleet_cves_review_input: The continuity proposal differs from the present immutable-baseline verifier.
compliance_finding: The shared exact-CVE verifier still returns MISSING when the deployed identity changes from the link baseline.
joint_review_question: Review A-to-B remediation, recurrence, rollback, and closure evidence without overwriting baseline history.

systems_review_input: System plans can be direct-policy, bundle-related, or exact-CVE plans.
fleet_cves_review_input: A canonical CVE/package pair is not automatically a bundle requirement.
compliance_finding: Bundle rollups use lineage/current memberships plus closure context and assignment references, not only the selected version.
joint_review_question: Decide when association means current responsibility, selected-version context, or historical reference.

treatment: Must agree where shared; defaults may differ
systems_review_input: Typed identity and availability must survive opening the same plan from a system.
fleet_cves_review_input: Scheduling requires valid typed ownership and remediation metadata; reuse preserves existing metadata.
compliance_finding: Generic policy creation permits weaker minimum fields and fixed default milestone dates.
joint_review_question: Approve minimum fields and family-specific defaults. Never infer authorization from assignee identity.

treatment: Must agree for the same record
systems_review_input: A plan opened from System Detail should expose the same valid record actions.
fleet_cves_review_input: Fleet triage may create or reuse a plan; opening it should not lose exact-CVE navigation.
compliance_finding: Compliance hosts the common tray but omits the CVE Evidence callback and shows policy-oriented controls.
joint_review_question: Use family-aware capabilities and complete caller adapters, not optional no-op behavior.

treatment: Shared transaction meaning; different family proofs
systems_review_input: Reported remediation completion, a new scan, verification, and closure are not the same operation.
fleet_cves_review_input: Exact-CVE closure needs the approved exact-absence proof, not accepted/scheduled status.
compliance_finding: Policy closure can use current Pass or an applicable accepted waiver; Close re-verifies and records attempts.
joint_review_question: Make lifecycle labels consistent while preserving each family evidence rule.

systems_review_input: System-origin actions need the same committed-result and conflict semantics as other callers.
fleet_cves_review_input: Fleet triage builds its mutation detail before commit, as recorded in the CVEs draft.
compliance_finding: Generic creation commits before detail loading; failed Close commits attempt/revision before 412.
joint_review_question: Define receipt, unknown-outcome reconciliation, and retry rules per action.

systems_review_input: System relationships, lists, and badges need invalidation after common plan mutations.
fleet_cves_review_input: The CVEs draft identifies stale parent lists/statistics after triage.
compliance_finding: Compliance uses local callbacks; Verify can reset drafts without notifying the parent.
joint_review_question: Specify affected-resource invalidation and draft-preserving saved-state updates.

systems_review_input: Retained evidence and current evidence need distinct return targets.
fleet_cves_review_input: Scheduled/historical inventory navigation must retain the selected target rather than default to Current.
compliance_finding: Policy zero-candidate navigation can panic; exact-CVE callback and policy retired-history presentation are incomplete.
joint_review_question: Support current, link-baseline, and closure evidence with explicit return context and revision-bound paging.

systems_review_input: A system export must identify exact evidence rather than rely on the page heading.
fleet_cves_review_input: Fleet exports must preserve canonical pair identity and defined inventory/count scope.
compliance_finding: Client Compliance exports can drop revision/scope and manufacture authoritative-looking metadata.
joint_review_question: Use one validated export manifest; distinguish observation, export, verification, and closure timestamps.

systems_review_input: Opening one system should not make previously existing fleet failures appear for the first time without explanation.
fleet_cves_review_input: Occurrence-based fleet counts and persistent plan-finding records are not necessarily the same population.
compliance_finding: Evidence GET materializes policy finding identities; complete background population was not established.
joint_review_question: Prove stable counts before any drawer or export is opened; define reconciliation ownership and lag.
